title: BMA executor terminal types
description: v1.1 terminal.* control methods (machine-scoped executors). PTY bytes never cross the control channel: each terminal.attach makes the executor dial one outbound host WebSocket (subprotocol bma.terminal.v1) that carries exactly one attachment.

TerminalHost.description: Outbound host socket for one attach. The ticket is a single-use, short-lived bearer credential sent only in the Authorization header, never in the URL.

TerminalOpenResult.description: terminal.open result. epoch starts at 1 and increments when the executor recreates the PTY under the same terminal_id; attach is fenced by it.

TerminalAttachResult.description: terminal.attach result, returned after the host socket is connected and the attached frame was written on it.

TerminalCloseResult.description: terminal.close result. Idempotent: closing an unknown or closed terminal returns closed=true.

TerminalErrorData.description: JSON-RPC error.data of a failed terminal.* call. terminal_code is the bma.terminal.v1 code the harness relays to the attach (for example terminal_writer_busy).
